_help: Tiles on the launcher and the phone's Apps tab. kind: 'url' opens a link/protocol, 'exe' runs a program, 'web' opens a site full screen in Edge (own sign-in profile; tv: true opens it as a smart TV, driven by the controller). Restart the server after editing. meta: the line under the title. games: non-Steam games for the Games row (same fields as apps, plus art/hero image URLs and a meta line; rockstar: true opens Rockstar's launcher and waits for its sign-in first). Tiles a PC doesn't have are hidden there: an exe needs its program, a url a program for its link type, and "needs": "<path>" hides any entry when that path is missing.
